notes.title: Game delay notice
notes.notes:
Dear all:
Thank you for your support for “Bounty Killer”. We regret to announce the “Bounty Killer” will be delayed Reasons for some teammate. The new release date will be announced as soon as possible. 

We are composed of a group of game developers who have ideals,but lack fund and media promotion. Although having been working together for long, two of our important programmers leave us out of personal reasons. We did our utmost to retain them, but they were determined to leave. On account of being unable to find appropriate new members to take over their work immediately and show you a semi-finished product for experience, we have no choice but to declare the postponement for the project. Anyhow, even in face of such difficulties, we’ll never give up and try out best to release the game as soon as possible. Thank you again for your support to our game and apologize for the delay.

Galaxy Game Studio A-Team
